verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS compliance and security platform, so user control over retention and deletion of the data it holds is a fair question. The pack documents no retention settings or data-deletion controls. Removing frameworks (which prunes unused controls), deleting the AWS role to revoke Oneleet's access, and MDM remote actions on devices are adjacent features, not control over data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
